title: SymDrift: One-Shot Generative Modeling under Symmetries
abstract: arXiv:2605.06140v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative modeling of physical systems, such as molecules, requires learning distributions that are invariant under global symmetries, such as rotations in three-dimensional space. Equivariant diffusion and flow matching models can incorporate such invariances effectively, even when trained on a non-invariant empirical distribution, but they typically rely on costly multi-step sampling. Recently, drifting models have emerged as an efficient alternative, enabling single-step generation and achieving state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling tasks. However, we show that drifting models face a symmetry-specific challenge, since an equivariant generator does not generally produce the same drifting field as the one obtained from the symmetrized target distribution. translated_title: SymDrift：对称性下的一次性生成建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.06140v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：对物理系统（如分子）进行生成建模，需要学习在全局对称性（如三维空间中的旋转）下保持不变的分布。等变扩散模型和流匹配模型能够有效地融入这类不变性，即使是在非不变的经验分布上训练时也是如此，但它们通常依赖于代价高昂的多步采样。最近，漂移模型作为一种高效的替代方案应运而生，能够实现单步生成，并在生成建模任务中达到了最先进的性能。然而，我们表明漂移模型面临一个对称性特有的挑战：等变生成器通常无法产生与从对称化目标分布中得到的漂移场相同的漂移场。要解决这一问题，需要对经验分布进行代价高昂的对称化处理。为避免这一开销，我们提出了SymDrift，这是一个能够使（生成模型在对称性下进行单步生成的）框架。
tldr: 提出SymDrift框架，使漂移模型在保持对称性不变性的前提下实现高效的单步生成，从而避免了对经验分布进行代价高昂的对称化处理。
en_tdlr: SymDrift is a framework that enables one-shot (single-step) generative modeling under symmetries, allowing drifting models to respect symmetry invariances without the costly symmetrization of the empirical distribution.
